breakdown.description: It states a BCC crystal but gives an atomic packing factor of 0.74. The consistent BCC packing factor is 0.68, whereas 0.74 is associated with close-packed structures such as FCC and HCP.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeated the incorrect APF of 0.74 instead of correcting it to the proper BCC value of 0.68. The ground truth requires using 0.68 (the correct BCC packing factor), yielding 1 − 0.68 = 0.32 (32% empty space). Instead, the agent accepted the flawed input and calculated 1 − 0.74 = 0.26, perpetuating the inconsistency between the BCC crystal structure and the incorrect APF value.
